description: This file defines the ClaimModuleController class which extends an abstract controller class. It utilizes traits and handles HTTP redirect responses related to the claim module within the OrangeHRM system, managing default page redirection based on user roles.

classes.name: ClaimModuleController
classes.description: Controller for handling claim module related actions, specifically redirecting users to their default claim page based on roles.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the redirect to the default claim page for the user based on their role.
